intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The student council room. Labeled folders, a large binder, and a thermos of coffee. Someone has placed a pen in your hand.

hello.speaker: java
hello.text: Good morning. Allow me to formally introduce myself: public, static, Julian Duke, President. You may call me President Duke.

teach.speaker: java
teach.text: Every Java program begins in main, inside a class. Every word is there for a reason, and I will happily explain each one. First, though, the greeting.

passed.speaker: java
passed.text: Properly declared, properly printed. You'd make an excellent council member, {player}.

failed.speaker: java
failed.text: I can't accept this. ...Here. We'll go through it again. Slowly.

bye.speaker: java
bye.text: Very well. I'll file it under "pending".
